purpose: Teach: どん底/城壁/順応/蒸発/牽制/発着/老齢/海戦

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、国家がどん底から立ち直った事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered national recovery from crisis in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging. Gentle confirmation rather than interrogation. Opens with his name as recognition. Steady, interested pace — the tone of a teacher checking in, not testing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、中世の城壁建築史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about medieval castle-wall construction history.
lines.style: Polite, slightly formal. Measured delivery with careful precision — Ren accounting for himself. A pause before starting, gathering the right words. Respectful toward the teacher.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、生物の環境順応研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You focused on biological adaptation to environment in your research, I recall?
lines.style: Thoughtful, as if genuinely reflecting on what she's heard. Not accusatory — more like thinking aloud with him. Slight pause before the observation, warm curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、近代の蒸発事件の社会学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the sociology of disappearance cases in the modern period.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. No defensiveness — just stating fact. The slight formality of someone who's learned to present his work clearly despite his natural shyness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国家間の牽制関係を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote about the deterrent relationships between nations, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged, genuinely interested. A light note of recognition — she's following the thread of his work. Conversational but attentive, leaning in slightly with her tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、空港の発着史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the history of airport arrivals and departures.
lines.style: Quiet, direct. The faintest hint of self-consciousness — he knows these topics may seem scattered. No apology in his voice, but awareness. Clear enunciation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、老齢化社会の論点を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The issues of an aging society — you addressed those in a paper, I believe?
lines.style: Reflective, gently probing. The tone suggests she's noticing something, piecing things together. Warm but with subtle undercurrent of gentle concern. Paced to invite response.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、近代の主要海戦を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the major naval battles of the modern era.
lines.style: Brief, close. A small exhale underneath — weariness or resignation creeping in. Still polite, still correct, but the energy is settling. Closing statement, not opening to more.
